categories.main_business_segments: CEC Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: water environment governance, solid and hazardous waste treatment, and flue gas treatment. The company also develops digital smart environmental protection solutions and operates an industrial innovation platform. Its services cover industrial water treatment, municipal sewage and water environment governance, sludge coupling treatment, soil remediation, kitchen waste treatment, flue gas and VOCs treatment, high-end equipment manufacturing, and smart environmental protection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as zero discharge wastewater treatment, nanofiltration membrane separation, full membrane water treatment, sludge drying coupling treatment, and integrated flue gas desulfurization and denitrification technologies including CCFB semi-dry desulfurization and HTR-3SO denitrification. It integrates R&D, core equipment manufacturing, system integration, EPC contracting, facility operation, and project investment. The company also develops digital platforms leveraging IoT, AI, big data, and automation for smart environmental management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CEC serves key industrial sectors including power generation (nuclear, thermal, renewable), petrochemical, metallurgy, coal chemical, coal mining, new energy, and municipal clients. Its customers include major national industrial enterprises and government entities. The company also extends services to overseas markets in Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Belt and Road countries. It targets industrial water treatment, municipal sewage treatment, sludge treatment, hazardous waste disposal, and flue gas treatment markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive projects across multiple provinces and cities including Nanjing, Suzhou, Henan, Ningxia, and others. It also has international presence with projects in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, and other Belt and Road countries. The company’s subsidiaries and joint ventures are located in key Chinese cities such as Nanjing, Suzhou, Wuhan, Guiyang, and Changshu.
categories.supply_chain_position: CEC operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain. It provides integrated environmental governance solutions including technology development, equipment manufacturing, engineering contracting, facility operation, and project investment. The company acts as a system integrator and service provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in zero discharge wastewater treatment, membrane technologies, sludge drying coupling, soil and groundwater remediation, flue gas ultra-low emission technologies, and digital smart environmental platforms. It emphasizes innovation through industry-academia collaboration, technology incubation, and industrial innovation platforms. Strategic focus includes expanding into new industrial sectors, enhancing digitalization and intelligence in environmental management, and developing new resource recovery technologies such as lithium extraction from salt lakes.
categories.revenue_model: CEC generates revenue primarily through engineering contracting (EPC, EP, EPCO), BOT and O&M projects, equipment sales, technology licensing, and operation services. Revenue streams include project construction fees, operation and maintenance service fees, equipment manufacturing and sales, and investment returns from industrial projects. The company also receives government subsidies and grants related to environmental projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CEC is positioned as a leading specialized environmental governance service provider in China with strong market share in industrial water treatment, municipal sewage treatment, sludge coupling treatment, and flue gas treatment. It competes with other national and regional environmental engineering firms and technology providers. The company leverages its comprehensive technology portfolio, project experience, and innovation platforms to maintain competitive advantages in key segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 837 million, a 16.77% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 74 million, down 13.58%. Total assets were around RMB 2.7 billion with net assets of RMB 1.88 billion. Despite revenue decline, operating cash flow improved significantly by 181.48%. The company maintains a stable financial scale with ongoing investments in R&D and innovation platforms to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CEC emphasizes integrated environmental governance solutions combining advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive project execution capabilities, and digital smart management platforms. Its unique value lies in zero discharge wastewater treatment, membrane separation technologies, sludge drying coupling, and ultra-low emission flue gas treatment. The company offers full lifecycle services from R&D, equipment manufacturing, engineering contracting to operation and maintenance, providing customers with energy-efficient, low-pollution, and intelligent environmental solutions tailored to industrial and municipal needs.
